RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the May 14, 2002/Vaisakha 24, 1924 (Saka)
————

Visa-on-arrival scheme
*681. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of TOURISM AND CULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention
has been drawn to the news-item which
appeared in The Hindustan Times dated
the 12th April, 2002, to the effect that the
'Visa-on-arrival' scheme announced to be
operational from 1st April, 2002, is likely
to be delayed considerably due to various
constraints and differences in perception
of concerned Ministries, like Home
Affairs, Civil Aviation, etc.; and
(b) if so, the details of difficulties being
encountered and the steps taken to remove
the bottlenecks so as to implement the
scheme in a time-bound manner to boost
the sagging tourism industry?
Grant for Chhattisgarh under
Library Development Scheme
†*682. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of TOURISM AND
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
a demand for additional grant for state
level library under the Library
Development Scheme from the
Government of Chhattisgarh;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when necessary orders in this
regard will be issued by Government?
World Bank Loan to Andhra Pradesh
†*683. SHRI B.P. SINGHAL: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether World Bank is extending
a monetary loan of 250 million dollars to
the Andhra Pradesh Government;
(b) whether the Department for
International Development (DFID) of
Britain has also offered to extend
monetary loan to any other State;
(c) whether Government have
permitted both of them to extend loans;
and
(d) if so, whether the direct inflow of
foreign money in States will endanger the
sovereignty and unity of India?
Airstrips in Rajasthan
†*684. DR. ABRAR AHMED: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:

(a) the places in Rajasthan where new
airstrips are proposed to be constructed
alongwith the cost of each of these
airstrips and the present status of the one
proposed to be constructed at Ajmer;
(b) whether Government propose to
construct an airstrip at Sawai Madhopur,
a major tourist spot in Rajasthan which is
also famous for Ranthambor Tiger Project
and whether Government are aware that
it will boost tourist industry of the
country; and
(c) by when, international flights will
be introduced from Jaipur, one of the
major airports of Rajasthan?
Coffee production
*685. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of annual coffee
production and consumption in the
country during the last three years;
(b) whether it is a fact that supply of
coffee has outstripped the demand in the
country resulting in a loss of remunerative
prices for the coffee growers;
(c) if so, the details in this regard;
(d) whether coffee growers in the
country have demanded relief measures
from the Central Government for tiding
over the crisis faced by them; and
(e) if so, the details in this regard and
Government's reaction thereto?
Debts of Highly Indebted Poor
countries
*686. SHRI ABANI ROY:
SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
announced their decision to write-off the
debt owned to it by the highly indebted
poor countries;
(b) if so, the names of the highly
indebted poor countries in the World to
whom India has provided loans;
(c) the quantum of debt owned by those
countries and under what terms and
conditions such loans were given; and
(d) the advantage to Government for
writing off such debts?
Scarcity of water in Rajasthan
†*687. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of WATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Rajasthan falls under the
category of worst affected State as far as
potable water is concerned;
(b) whether there is a acute scarcity of
potable water in Rajasthan and many
districts of the State have to face the
problem of polluted and floride
contaminated water;
(c) whether any scheme is under
Government's consideration to provide
Rajasthan with some special financial
package to make available pure potable
water to the people of Rajasthan placing
the State under special category in respect
of crisis of potable water under the
National water policy; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Acquisition of aircrafts by Air India
*688. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
 DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

WIN2\SESSION\858rs 208
(a) whether Air India has prepared its
own plan to acquire 23 new aircrafts over
the next five years;
(b) whether Air India is suffering
losses continuously for the last three
years;
(c) whether during 2001-2002
Air India had earned a net profit of
Rs. 30 crore;
(d) if so, whether in view of this, Air
India has prepared a Rs. 10,000 crore
acquisition plan;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) by when the plan is likely to be
implemented?
Development of tourist circuits
*689. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of TOURISM AND
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to throw open development of new tourist
circuits in the country to foreigners;
(b) if so, the tourist circuits proposed
to be given for development together with
the name of States in which they are
located; and
(c) the conditions on which this
development is to be done?
Excise duty exemption on cement in
Gujarat
*690. SHRI BACHANI LEKHRAJ:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Gujarat
Government has requested the Central
Government for exemption of excise duty
on sale of cement to the earthquake
affected people for rehabilitation and
reconstruction work;
(b) if so, whether Government have
given full excise duty exemption to
cement from 1st June, 2001; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Money deposited in Indian banks
through hawala transactions
*691. SHRI LAJPAT RAI: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
large sum of money has been deposited
in Indian banks through hawala
transactions from Pakistan;
(b) if so, whether this money is being
used by terrorist outfits through their
contacts in Agra, Saharanpur, Delhi, Surat
and Hazaribagh, etc.;
(c) whether these bank accounts have
been confiscated and action taken against
guilty persons; and
(d) if so, the details in this regard?
Funds for flood control
*692. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of normal flood and
erosion control projects submitted by the
Government of Assam during the last
three years alongwith the date of
submission, date of final clearance for
execution, total outlay, year-wise amount
sanctioned, utilized, progress made and
target set, scheme-wise; and
(b) the total outlay, amount disbursed
and achievement made on utilization of
fund from the PM's special package for
Rs. 500 crores?

209
WIN2\SESSION\858rs 209
Donations for Annadhana Scheme in
Tamil Nadu
*693. SHRI SATISH PRADHAN: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Tamil Nadu
Government has requested to grant
income tax exemption to donations
received by the devotees for the
Annadhana Scheme which is being
implemented in Tamil Nadu; and
(b) if so, what is Government's
response thereto?
Report of Pension-Reform Committee
*694. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Pension-Reform
Committee has submitted its report to
Government;
(b) if so, the salient points of the report;
(c) the total fund required for
disbursement of pension in the current
financial year;
(d) the projections for the coming five
years; and
(e) what is the additional liability to
Government towards pension based on the
Fifth Pay Commission Report?
Subsidies to refineries and producers
*695. SHRI HARENDRA SINGH
MALIK: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) the wholesale ex-storage price of
kerosene, diesel and LPG paid to different
refineries/producers;
(b) the rates and amount of different
Central and State taxes, duties etc. leading
to final price build up at which these
products are available to consumers in
Uttar Pradesh and Haryana; and
(c) the manner in which subsidy is
given to refineries/producers/consumers?
Classification of banks as fragile
*696.SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether several banks in the Indian
banking system have been classified as
being fragile and having a negative
network;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the factors responsible for such
Indian banks being classified as fragile;
(d) whether Government have taken
any steps to tone up the functioning of
such banks; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Development of Bangalore Airport
*697. SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Bangalore
airport handles approximately 100 flights
a day and about two lakh passengers in a
month;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
existing infrastructure is insufficient to
meet the demands of the passengers; and
(c) if so, the details of the steps
Government propose to take for
infrastructure development of Bangalore
airport till the completion of
Devenahalli airport for the ever growing
passenger traffic and its International
importance?

210
WIN2\SESSION\858rs 210
Profit of nationalised vis-a-vis foreign
banks
*698. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the nationalised banks and
financial institutions have improved their
performance and profits;
(b) the comparative figures in terms
of profit with that of foreign banks for the
past three years; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
improve the functioning and profitability
of these financial institutions and banks
keeping in view the acute competition by
the foreign banks?
Irrigation water management
†*699. PROF. R.B.S. VARMA: Will
the Minister of WATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have formulated a new scheme for
irrigation water management in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) by when, this scheme is likely to
be started; and
(d) the amount proposed to be allotted
by Government for this scheme?
Earnings on import of crude oil
*700. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of taxes, customs and
excise duties Government have earned on
import of crude oil and refining of
petroleum products for the year
2001-2002;
(b) what is the projected amount of
taxes Government will be earning in the
year 2002-2003 by way of customs duty
on import of crude oil and refining of
petroleum products for the year
2002-2003; and
(c) what is the quantum of subsidy
Government will be spending on LPG and
Kerosene for the year 2002-2003?

(a) whether Government have approved
